title: Local actual maps from strictly perfect ringed-site complexes
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a site with a sheaf of commutative rings, with module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and unbounded derived category and localization $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $U$ be a site object and use restrictions to the localized ringed site $(\mathcal C/U,\mathcal O_U)$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Let $P^\bullet,F^\bullet$ be cochain complexes of $\mathcal O_U$-modules. Assume $P^\bullet$ is strictly perfect: it is zero outside finitely many degrees and each $P^j$ is a direct summand of a finite free $\mathcal O_U$-module. For every morphism $u:Q(P^\bullet)\to Q(F^\bullet)$ in $D(\mathcal O_U)$ there is a covering $\{U_i\to U\}$ and chain maps $u_i:P^\bullet|_{U_i}\to F^\bullet|_{U_i}$ whose images under localization equal $u|_{U_i}$. No boundedness assumption is imposed on $F^\bullet$.

proof.text: Apply the left calculus of fractions of [lem-pc-quasi-isomorphisms-multiplicative-system] to the abelian category of $\mathcal O_U$-modules. Choose a complex $G^\bullet$ and chain maps $\beta:P^\bullet\to G^\bullet$, $f:F^\bullet\to G^\bullet$, with $f$ a quasi-isomorphism and $u=Q(f)^{-1}\circ Q(\beta)$. Here the homotopy category has complexes as objects and homotopy classes of chain maps as morphisms, so the numerator and denominator can be represented by actual chain maps. This is the fraction formula implemented by Mathlib DerivedCategory.left_fac; it imposes no bound on either target complex.

Choose $a\in\mathbf Z$ below the finite support of $P^\bullet$; for the zero complex any $a$ works. Apply [lem-sfb-ringed-site-strict-perfect-local-lift] with its $E=P$, its $F=G$, its $G=F$, its $u=\beta$ and its $v=f$. Every term of $P$ is a finite-free direct summand by hypothesis. Since $f$ is a quasi-isomorphism, $H^j(f)$ is an isomorphism for all $j$, hence is an isomorphism for $j>a$ and surjective for $j=a$. The lemma gives a covering $\{U_i\to U\}$ and actual chain maps $u_i:P|_{U_i}\to F|_{U_i}$ with $f|_{U_i}\circ u_i$ chain homotopic to $\beta|_{U_i}$. Both $F$ and $G$ may be unbounded.

For each covering member, restriction on module sheaves is exact by [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact], applied on $\mathcal C/U$. Relocalization [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] identifies its slice at $U_i\to U$ with $\mathcal C/U_i$. By [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization], termwise restriction preserves quasi-isomorphisms and its localization comparison is natural. Thus the restriction of the fraction in Step 1 is $u|_{U_i}=Q_i(f|_{U_i})^{-1}\circ Q_i(\beta|_{U_i})$, with the canonical comparison isomorphisms understood. Localization factors through the homotopy category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], so the homotopy in Step 2 gives $Q_i(f|_{U_i})\circ Q_i(u_i)=Q_i(\beta|_{U_i})$. The first factor is invertible because the restricted $f$ is a quasi-isomorphism. Multiplying by its inverse gives $Q_i(u_i)=u|_{U_i}$, as required.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q148-ec1a91d72 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the item in full; there are no new nodes. The statement is unchanged from live and matches Stacks 08FR(1) (sites-cohomology.tex lemma-local-actual) together with definition-strictly-perfect (l.11717): arbitrary ringed site, object U, E strictly perfect, F unbounded. There is no re-split note, and live/side-live still have the item unsplit. Step 1: left fraction u=Q(f)^{-1}Q(beta) with f:F->G a quasi-isomorphism, from lem-pc-quasi-isomorphisms-multiplicative-system (Mathlib leaf). This matches Stacks' alpha=f^{-1}beta and the orientation of Mathlib left_fac. Step 2: the substitution into lem-sfb-ringed-site-strict-perfect-local-lift (08FQ, same unit, unsplit, so no cycle) is E=P, F=G, G=F, u=beta, v=f, with a below the support of P. A quasi-isomorphism meets the weaker H^j hypothesis; the step yields f|∘u_i ≃ beta|. Step 3: restriction to C/U_i is exact (lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact on C/U, plus the relocalization clause of def-pur-localized-ringed-site). lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization gives preservation of quasi-isomorphisms and a natural phi, so u|_{U_i}=Q_i(f|)^{-1}Q_i(beta|). Q factors through K, the homotopy gives Q_i(f|)Q_i(u_i)=Q_i(beta|), and cancelling gives Q_i(u_i)=u|_{U_i}; I checked this cancellation. proof_deps is exactly the union of uses. Edge cases checked: P=0, acyclic F, F unbounded on both sides, zero ring, empty covering. Duplicate search (rg -L for 08FR/08FQ/strictly perfect) found only étale or constant-coefficient variants, none stating the general ringed-site result. The tool_use lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact (unit sk-def-sf-operations) is actually on the route, since sk-thm-sf-ctf-stability uses sk-def-sf-operations, and it is Lean-closed. The declaration is redundant; accepted. from.node was filled as det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-direct-images, the endpoint of the via chain, and the proof (3) place was checked. No SGA. Searches cover all three kinds. No changes.
